decisions.decision: Publish at /adp-notion, as the spec and its Verbatim Constraints say
decisions.why: The reviewed spec changed to it so no site address can clash with an add-on; it is a folder beside the site output
decisions.rejected: /adp/notion, the original input, which lies inside the site Astro output

decisions.decision: The site deploy workflow checks out etalii.adp.ide.notion at develop, runs its build script into dist/adp-notion and uploads one artifact
decisions.why: A Pages deployment replaces the whole domain, so only one deployment holding both keeps both
decisions.rejected: A Pages site in the Notion repository (served on github.io, not etalii.net); an organization site holding the domain; cross-repository artifacts

decisions.decision: A publish job in the Notion Build workflow starts the site deploy by workflow_dispatch with the secret SITE_DEPLOY_TOKEN
decisions.why: deploy.yml already accepts a dispatch and Actions write is the narrowest permission
decisions.rejected: A schedule on deploy; a GitHub App; repository_dispatch needing Contents write

decisions.decision: The Notion repository owns scripts/build.mjs, Node without dependencies, which generates the index and names its own revision
decisions.why: Only its checkout knows its revision, and the site job already has Node
decisions.rejected: A hand-written index.html; a Python script

decisions.decision: One add-on per folder addons/<id>/, served at /adp-notion/<id>/
decisions.why: The address depends only on the folder name

decisions.decision: On the site Notion is a listed host (listedHostIds, hosts.yaml, state planned), not a catalogue host
decisions.why: FR-015 asks only that the host is named with no tool; a catalogue column belongs to the first add-on
decisions.rejected: Adding notion to hostIds; a home-page sentence only

decisions.decision: Host is redefined as an environment; IDE host is kept for the four IDEs; the catalogue workspace becomes the Notion workspace
decisions.why: Existing uses of IDE host stay true, so no specification changes
decisions.rejected: Rewording every IDE host and four hosts across repositories

decisions.decision: Amend the constitution to 1.5.0 and the site principles to 1.2.0 in this feature
decisions.why: Both name the hosts, and the site principle says no other repository is involved in etalii.net
decisions.rejected: Leaving them and recording a standing violation

concerns.note: SITE_DEPLOY_TOKEN is a fine-grained personal token: a maintainer must create it and it expires within a year; the publish job then fails visibly
A failing site test or check holds back an add-on publication, since both go through the site deploy
.spec-context.json specName, intent and coverage titles and checklists/requirements.md still say /adp/notion

Plan marks site principle II (Sourced, Never Retyped) as PASS, but T032 adds the notion host entry to hosts.yaml by hand; the deviation is not in Complexity Tracking, and T032 omits the required source field method

Plan and quickstart say four pull requests and two maintainer steps; tasks.md says five pull requests and seven maintainer tasks

plan.summary: Plan, research, data model, three contracts and a quickstart for the Notion host repository across four repositories
plan.key_finding: GitHub Pages serves one deployment per domain, so /adp-notion can only be published by the site deploy workflow carrying the Notion repository output

tasks.summary: 46 tasks in 6 phases: setup, the glossary and rules (pull request 1), one phase per story across the Notion repository, the site and the profile, then validation and delivery; 7 are a maintainer's

approach: Rename and set up etalii.adp.ide.notion with a Build workflow and a dependency-free Node build script that writes an index and one folder per add-on. The site's deploy workflow checks that repository out, builds it into dist/adp-notion and publishes it with the site; a publish job in the Notion repository starts that workflow with a token. The glossary, rules, constitution, site principles, both build tables and the site's host list name Notion as a host.
